### Read and format data
```{r reading_data}

Bai.seurat <- readRDS("Exported_RDS_files/Bai_combined.rds")

Bald.seurat <- readRDS("Data/Bald_seurat_object_filt.rds")

```


## Combine datasets {.tabset}

### Integrate data

```{r Integrate_celltypes}

# Set activate assay to RNA
DefaultAssay(Bai.seurat) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Bald.seurat) <- "RNA"


# Create a unified metadata column
Bai.seurat@meta.data$celltype_unified <- Bai.seurat@meta.data$celltype
Bald.seurat@meta.data$celltype_unified <- Bald.seurat@meta.data$seurat_clusters

# Create matching metadata columns in Bai dataset
Bai.seurat@meta.data$organ <- "Liver_Bai"
Bai.seurat@meta.data$organ_celltype <- paste0(Bai.seurat@meta.data$organ, "_", Bai.seurat@meta.data$celltype_unified)

# Create metadata 
Bai.seurat@meta.data$dataset <- "Bai"
Bald.seurat@meta.data$dataset <- "Bald"

# set idents 
Idents(Bai.seurat) <- Bai.seurat@meta.data$celltype_unified
Idents(Bald.seurat) <- Bald.seurat@meta.data$celltype_unified


# Create list of seurat objects
seurat.list <- list(Bai = Bai.seurat, Bald = Bald.seurat)

# Find Integration Anchors
immune.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat.list, 
                                         anchor.features = 2000, 
                                         scale = TRUE, 
                                         normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                                         reduction = "cca", 
                                         l2.norm = TRUE,
                                         dims = 1:30,
                                         k.anchor = 5,
                                         k.filter = 200,
                                         k.score = 30,
                                         max.features = 200,
                                         nn.method = "rann",
                                         eps = 0,
                                         verbose = TRUE)

# Integrate dataset
seurat.combined <- IntegrateData(anchorset = immune.anchors,
                                 new.assay.name = "integrated",
                                 normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                                 dims = 1:30,
                                 k.weight = 100,
                                 sd.weight = 1,
                                 verbose = TRUE)


# Basic overview of data
seurat.combined # 28488 genes and 12,494 cells 

Bai.seurat # 4,388 cells
Bald.seurat # 8,106 cells



# Format metadata in integrated seurat object
seurat.combined@meta.data$dataset <- factor(seurat.combined@meta.data$dataset, 
                                             levels = c("Bai", "Bald"))

# Set default assay
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined) <- "integrated"


# Find variable genes
seurat.combined <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.combined,
                                        selection.method = "vst",
                                        nfeatures = 2000,
                                        verbose = TRUE)
# scale data
seurat.combined <- ScaleData(seurat.combined,
                             vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mito"),
                             model.use = "linear",
                             do.scale = TRUE,
                             do.center = TRUE,
                             verbose = TRUE)


# Remove unnecessary data
rm(Bai.seurat, 
   Bald.seurat, 
   immune.anchors, 
   seurat.list)

```





## Analysis {.tabset}
### Dim reduction - integrated dataset
```{r Dim_reduction_integrated_dataset}

# Set assay 
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined) <- "integrated"

###########
# Run PCA
###########

seurat.combined <- RunPCA(seurat.combined, 
                             features = seurat.combined@assays$integrated@var.features,
                             npcs = 50,
                             verbose = TRUE, 
                             rev.pca = TRUE,
                             seed.use = 42)


###########
# UMAP
###########

seurat.combined <- RunUMAP(seurat.combined,
                              reduction = "pca",
                              dims = 1:20,
                              umap.method = "uwot", 
                              n.neighbors = 45, # 5 to 50 // 45
                              min.dist = 0.5, # Sensible values are in the range 0.001 to 0.5 // 0.5
                              seed.use = 42)




###########################
# Cluster identification 
###########################

seurat.combined <- FindNeighbors(seurat.combined,
                                    dims = 1:30)

seurat.combined <- FindClusters(seurat.combined,
                                   resolution = 0.4)



```
 
 
### Visualisation of integrated data 
```{r visualisation_of_integrated_dataset}

# Create output dir
if(!dir.exists("output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets")){
  dir.create("output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets", 
             recursive = T)}


# Grouped by dataset

UMAPPlot(seurat.combined,
         label = TRUE,
         group.by = "dataset") + 
  ggtitle("Bai & Bald datasets") + 
  NoLegend()

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_by_dataset.pdf")
dev.off()

# Grouped by celltype

UMAPPlot(seurat.combined,
         label = TRUE,
         group.by = "celltype_unified") + 
  ggtitle("Bai & Bald datasets")

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_by_celltype.pdf")
dev.off()

# Grouped by organ and celltype

UMAPPlot(seurat.combined,
         label = TRUE,
         group.by = "organ_celltype") + 
  ggtitle("Bai & Bald datasets") 

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_by_organ_celltype.pdf")
dev.off()

# Grouped by organ

UMAPPlot(seurat.combined,
         label = TRUE,
         cols = c("red", "Grey", "Blue"),
         group.by = "organ") + 
  ggtitle("Bai & Bald datasets") 

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_by_organ.pdf")
dev.off()


# Grouped by cluster

UMAPPlot(seurat.combined,
         label = TRUE,
         group.by = "seurat_clusters") + 
  ggtitle("Bai & Bald datasets") + 
  NoLegend()

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_by_cluster.pdf")
dev.off()



# Subset for spleen ILC1s
Idents(seurat.combined) <- seurat.combined@meta.data$organ_celltype

temp.seurat <- subset(seurat.combined, idents = c("Spleen_ILC1"))


p1 <- UMAPPlot(temp.seurat,
         label = TRUE,
         pt.size = 2,
         group.by = "organ_celltype") + 
  ggtitle("Cluster")

p2 <- UMAPPlot(temp.seurat,
         label = TRUE,
         pt.size = 2,
         group.by = "seurat_clusters") + 
  ggtitle("Cluster")

p1|p2


dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/UMAP_integrated_datasets/UMAP_just_spleen_ILC1.pdf")
dev.off()


```
